text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... I didn't reach her! Ikuno's 
gotten so strong~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, but onto the next one! I'll 
train what needs training and give it my 
all next time!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Tannhauser-san.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for today, 
Tannhauser-san.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What's with the sudden formality~?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I went into this 'Yasuda Kinen' in peak 
condition.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The result was satisfying. However, I was 
also reminded that letting one's guard 
down is strictly forbidden.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Because it was the kind of race that made 
me feel like you'd catch up to me in no 
time.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I'll be counting on you again next time.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Teehee. I see. That's kinda 
embarrassing. Same here, looking forward 
to next time too."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
By the way, there's a place I'd like to 
stop by on the way back, would that be all 
right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Meaning?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It's a super sento public bath.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Public baths are expected to offer various 
relaxing effects, including thermal and 
hydrostatic pressure benefits.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In other words, "heal when you're tired." 
This cycle is the key to your future 
health.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I-I seeee!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, let's go right 
away. Soaking for too long has the 
opposite effect, so don't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa~~, so warm and toasty. I feel warm 
right down to my core~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I'll sleep well tonight... 
*yaaawn*.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad to hear that. ...Please 
don't fall asleep here, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In any case, warming both body and mind at 
the public bath, the two gained vitality 
for what lay ahead.
